operations.notes: Authenticated personal context only; no client accountId; cursor bound to caller/context/snapshot.
Exact-store asset-read permission, not refund signing permission; recheck each page.
Explicit context validated server-side; balance grouping never grants signing or receipt access.
This candidate covers Cloud MPC personal-transfer approval contexts only; path walletId must match intent. HW uses BLE. Source-specific existing sessions stay on baseline until separately adapted.
This candidate covers personal EOA transfer only. Store context, smart accounts and unsupported profiles reject. No payment/refund sourceId accepted; source is server generated.

EOA submission: server loads original intent/source and dispatches original authorization. Personal candidate requires bound approval evidence; baseline guest payment and refund retain their source-specific checks. No mobile-login requirement for guest.
Original transaction-read authorization and exact transactionRef; signing/submit success is not chain confirmation.
Owner or exact-operation capability; walletFlow only for authorized candidate flow, otherwise null; never reveal another context or raw MPC/device proof.

httpBinding.queryEncoding: scalar UTF-8 query parameters; optional fields omitted, never string null; cursor token opaque
httpBinding.candidateNegotiation: Only explicit wallet-approval-candidate-1 clients use changed contracts. Unsupported version rejected; never retry silently with baseline. Baseline source-specific calls remain separate.

errors.meaning: Shape/unknown fields/version or invalid query serialization
Missing/expired credential, not proof of resource existence
Known authorized context lacks requested action
Resource absent or inaccessible; same external response
Same scoped key with different canonical input
Address nonce occupied/replaced; reconcile existing submission
Wrong source/request kind/account/profile; no blind-sign fallback
Evidence fails verifier/binding; do not disclose private mismatch details
No prior accepted submission and new dispatch prohibited
Recovered signer or parsed transaction differs
Retry timing separate from fresh approval
Dependency unavailable; unknown submission queries original operation

logicalResources.name: WalletChoiceProjection
logicalResources.rule: Caller/context-scoped projection, no new physical table implied

logicalResources.name: ApprovalBinding
logicalResources.anchor: transaction intent + operation + immutable selection snapshot
logicalResources.rule: Store context/payer/signer/epoch/digest/source at creation; verified evidence links to exact signature, not inferred from EOA alone

logicalResources.name: SignatureProvenance
logicalResources.anchor: device result verifier or MPC signing_sessions
logicalResources.rule: Only successful selected-profile verification binds actual signing route/epoch; unsupported proof profile rejects protected route

logicalResources.name: SubmissionDispatch
logicalResources.anchor: transaction submission + operation + source ledger + chain/address/nonce tracking
logicalResources.rule: Persist signed-payload fingerprint/hash/outbox before broadcast; identical retry returns original, different bytes conflict; external nonce competitors observed, not locked

sourceAdapters.rule: Guest attempt/device/session capability; no account or Cloud participant required

Smart account/UserOperation uses separate source adapter; not submitted as raw EOA candidate
